decision: Frozen until sample files from the team's own tool versions are provided: (1) native CAESAR II .cii export - stress route stays PCF + attribute map; (2) native AFT Fathom/Arrow files - hydraulic route stays PCF import; (3) AVEVA Process Simulation .simx - not generated, future route is importing APS results (Excel/CSV) as source data; (4) import testing of generated files inside Plant 3D, E3D, AVEVA Engineering, CAESAR II, AFT, MS Project and P6. Existing engines (pid, plot_plan, model_ifc, piping_pcf, aveva_export, schedule) stay as they are.
rationale: These formats and imports cannot be verified in the project environment; building them unverified would put unproven files into deliveries. Unfreeze by providing sample files and recording a new decision.
title: Freeze: native CII / AFT / APS .simx exports and in-tool import verification
